description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe, developing, operating and publishing products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K and Zynga, with its products currently designed for console gaming systems, mobile including smartphones and tablets, and personal computer, and it delivers its products through physical retail, digital download, online platforms and cloud streaming services. It derives substantially all of its revenue from the sale of its interactive entertainment content, which includes internally developed software titles and software titles developed by third parties, in-game virtual items and advertising, and live services on console, mobile and PC, and it directs its teams to anticipate and actively address changes in consumer behavior and technology so that it can evolve its business as new dynamics develop.
